method: initialize + tools/list (anonymous, no tool called; roadmap#992)

tools.name: search_cpt_codes
tools.title: CPT Code Search
tools.description: Canonical code-lookup tool for this server. Search Loa's CPT/HCPCS index using exact codes, clinical terms, or consumer phrases. Use this first when the user does not already know the CPT code, before calling pricing tools.

query.description: Concise procedure name, medical term, or candidate CPT code; omit personal narratives and identifiers (e.g. "knee MRI", "blood work", "99213")

tools.name: search_providers
tools.title: Provider Search
tools.description: Search public CMS NPI Registry data for clinicians and healthcare organizations by specialty, name, or location. Use returned provenance to understand the registry source and scope. Use this for provider lookup, not pricing.

name.description: Provider name to search for (e.g. "John Smith")

anyOf.description: Tracked Loa link. Share it when the user wants to book, contact, or learn more about this provider or hospital.

tools.name: get_pricing_estimate
tools.title: Pricing Estimate
tools.description: Quick cash-price ballpark for one or more CPT codes, using the median cash price across hospitals in the state (from zip_code) or nationally. priceRange is the typical range (25th to 75th percentile of hospitals). Codes without enough data return insufficient_data and are listed in missingCodes; the total is null unless every code has data. Never fill gaps with your own estimate. For insurer rates or hospital-specific prices, use get_market_pricing or get_hospital_pricing.

zip_code.description: ZIP code used to pick the state (omit for national figures)

tools.name: get_market_pricing
tools.title: Market Pricing
tools.description: Preferred benchmark pricing tool. Returns hospital-level market statistics for CPT codes from Loa's published hospital price-transparency data: cash/self-pay prices, list prices (gross charges before discounts), overall insurer-negotiated rates, and rates for the most common insurers. Each hospital counts once. Lead with the median and the p25-p75 range rather than min or max. Figures are statewide or national, never local to a ZIP code. When status is insufficient_data, say Loa doesn't have enough data instead of estimating, and always relay the limitations. Negotiated rates are not out-of-pocket costs.

state.description: State for regional pricing (e.g. "CA", "New York"). Unknown states return McpToolInvalidInput. When fewer than 5 hospitals in the state published a price, national figures are returned with a limitation.

zip_code.description: ZIP code, used only to pick the state when state is omitted

hospital_count.description: Hospitals behind this figure; each counts once
Hospitals behind this figure; each counts once
Hospitals behind this figure; each counts once

source_dates.description: Extraction dates of the underlying hospital files (YYYY-MM-DD)

tools.name: search_hospitals
tools.title: Hospital Search
tools.description: Search Loa's hospital directory by name or location and return hospital IDs plus address details. Use the returned hospital_ids with get_hospital_pricing to fetch source-labeled Published MRF and reviewed overlay prices.

state.description: Two-letter state code or full state name, e.g. "CA" or "New York".

anyOf.description: Tracked Loa link. Share it when the user wants to book, contact, or learn more about this provider or hospital.

tools.name: get_hospital_pricing
tools.title: Hospital Pricing
tools.description: Hospital-specific pricing tool for source-labeled Loa runtime data. Returns source-labeled Published MRF prices and Loa Verified Provider Price overlays for CPT codes. cash_price is the cash/self-pay price, list_price is the gross charge before discounts (most patients pay less), and insurance_prices are payer-negotiated rates for the named plan, not out-of-pocket costs. Any of these can be null when the hospital did not publish that price. Use this when comparing named hospitals or checking a quoted hospital price against available source rows.

cpt_codes.description: CPT procedure codes to look up pricing for

anyOf.description: Tracked Loa link. Share it when the user wants to book, contact, or learn more about this provider or hospital.

tools.name: compare_local_prices
tools.title: Compare Local Prices
tools.description: Compare hospitals near a ZIP code for one procedure code, ranked by price (or distance) only. Without insurer, price is the published cash (self-pay) price. With insurer, price is that insurer's negotiated rate, which is not the patient's out-of-pocket cost. Each option says what the price includes, its source and date, distance in miles, and loa_link for booking or contact. Every priced hospital in the radius is ranked before limit applies. Hospitals with no price for the code are counted in hospitals_without_price; hospitals without a matching cash price or insurer rate are listed last with price null. Get the code from search_cpt_codes first. Do not send member IDs or other personal details.

cpt_code.description: One CPT or HCPCS code, e.g. "73721" for a knee MRI

zip_code.description: 5-digit US ZIP code to search around

insurer.description: Insurance company name only, e.g. "Aetna" or "Blue Cross"; no member IDs

anyOf.description: Tracked Loa link. Share it when the user wants to book, contact, or learn more about this provider or hospital.

tools.name: search_entities
tools.title: Entity Search
tools.description: Search Loa runtime hospital and provider entity pages by name or state. Use this before get_entity_prices when the user names a hospital or provider but does not know the exact Loa slug.

query.description: Hospital or provider name to search for.

entity_type.description: Optional filter for hospital or provider entities.

state.description: Two-letter state code or full state name, e.g. CA or New York.

limit.description: Maximum number of results, default 20, max 50.

anyOf.description: Tracked Loa link. Share it when the user wants to book, contact, or learn more about this provider or hospital.

tools.name: get_entity_prices
tools.title: Entity Prices
tools.description: Return source-labeled prices for a Loa hospital or provider entity slug using the shared resolver. Use search_entities first if the slug is unknown. Results include provenance and explicit unavailable rows for requested CPT codes with no current price.

slug.description: Exact Loa entity slug from search_entities or a Loa SEO page.

cpt_codes.description: Optional CPT codes to filter. If omitted, returns current indexed prices up to the limit.

limit.description: Maximum number of prices, default 50, max 100.

anyOf.description: Tracked Loa link. Share it when the user wants to book, contact, or learn more about this provider or hospital.

tools.name: get_entity_profile
tools.title: Entity Profile
tools.description: Return one Loa hospital or provider entity profile by exact slug or entity_pages.id. Includes profile-field provenance so agents can distinguish source-file fields from Loa-reviewed overrides.

slug_or_id.description: Exact Loa entity slug or entity_pages.id from search_entities.

entity_type.description: Optional disambiguation when slug_or_id is a slug.

loa_link.description: Tracked Loa link. Share it when the user wants to book, contact, or learn more about this provider or hospital.

tools.name: explain_price_sources
tools.title: Explain Price Sources
tools.description: Explain the source labels, provenance, confidence, and caveats behind Loa prices for one hospital or provider entity. Use this when an agent needs to tell a user why prices are MRF-published, Loa-reviewed, estimated, or unavailable.

slug.description: Exact Loa entity slug from search_entities.

cpt_codes.description: Optional CPT codes to explain. If omitted, explains current indexed prices.

limit.description: Maximum number of prices to inspect, default 50, max 100.

tools.name: submit_entity_update_request
tools.title: Submit Entity Update Request
tools.description: Submit a profile, listing, or price correction for Loa review without requiring a provider portal. This is the only mutating provider/entity tool. It requires OAuth, captures submitter and source evidence, records linked-provider status when available, and never changes public data until Loa approves the request.

entity_page_id.description: Loa entity_pages.id for the provider or hospital.

entity_slug.description: Exact Loa entity slug if entity_page_id is not available.

entity_type.description: Entity kind for the requested update; use unknown only when it cannot be determined.

submitter_email.description: Work email for the submitting representative.

submitter_name.description: Name of the person submitting the request.

submitter_organization.description: Provider, hospital, or agent organization represented by the submitter.

submitter_role.description: Submitter role, such as billing manager or authorized agent.

submitter_phone.description: Optional callback phone number for reviewer follow-up.

source_urls.description: Optional public URLs reviewers can use to verify the submitted change.

source_notes.description: Short verification notes, source context, or callback instructions.

attestation.description: How the submitter is connected to the submitted evidence.

request_type.description: Type of reviewed change being requested.

proposed_changes.description: Structured profile or listing fields proposed for Loa review.

uploaded_file_url.description: Optional public URL for an uploaded evidence file.

idempotency_key.description: Optional stable retry key. Loa derives one from the payload if omitted.

price_items.description: Optional structured price rows proposed for Loa review.
